purpose: Define an AC-governed Expose editor for schemas, fields, relations, cardinalities and bindings, using shared Form/Node Graph primitives and candidate validation before apply.

topics.name: Schema and Relation Editor
topics.purpose: Define an AC-governed Expose editor for schemas, fields, relations, cardinalities and bindings, using shared Form/Node Graph primitives and candidate validation before apply.

semantics.form_rule: Field/type/constraint editing reuses Form Editor semantics.
semantics.graph_rule: Relation topology editing reuses Node Graph typed-edge semantics.
semantics.identity_rule: Schema/field/relation targets resolve by exact canonical identity.
semantics.validation_rule: Candidate edits validate refs, type/cardinality compatibility and relation integrity before apply.
semantics.migration_rule: Breaking schema change requires explicit evolution/migration workflow.
semantics.instance_rule: Editor modifies schema/relation definitions and does not directly rewrite instance data unless a separate migration operation is invoked.

invariants.rule: Schema, field and relation identities are explicit and stable; instance data, presentation labels and physical storage never define canonical schema semantics.

hard_gates.condition: field/relation target chosen by display label only
graph adjacency creates relation without explicit edge
breaking change directly rewrites instance data

references.purpose: Schema field editing reuses Form Editor.
